sections.name: File setup
sections.title: TypeScript checker settings
sections.what: Sets strict checking, the file list to check, and the shortcut from the at sign to the src folder. It also turns on the Next.js plugin.
sections.why: Strict checking and a clear file list keep the type check focused and reliable.
sections.watch_out: The include list must still cover new folders, or their code will not be checked.

summary: Settings for the TypeScript checker that tell it how strict to be and which files to check.
purpose: Controls how TypeScript reads and checks the code, and sets the shortcut that lets files import from the src folder with an at sign.
why: Strict settings catch more mistakes before the app runs.
how: The TypeScript tool reads these options first. It checks files under src and the Next.js type files, and skips the node_modules folder.
inputs: The source files under src and generated Next.js type files.
outputs: Type errors, or a clean check when there are none. Nothing is written because noEmit is on.
risks: Turning off strict mode or skipLibCheck would hide real problems. The include list must match where the code lives.
debug: If imports fail with an at sign path, check the paths entry. If a type error appears in a library file, check skipLibCheck.
